g.text: b The CRISPRi targets competing for acetyl-CoA
The isoprenol metabolic module of P. putida KT2440: 2958 reactions, 2178 metabolites, 1474 genes (iJN1463 plus the pIY670 route)
plasmid genes in red are constant across every strain; 14 CRISPRi target genes carry 49 of the 73 acetyl-CoA reactions
